headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by Sandy Alcantara's strong performance on the mound. Alcantara pitched 8.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Evan Carter, the Texas Rangers' center fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain. Other notable players on the injured list include Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates), Jack Flaherty (Detroit Tigers), Miguel Andujar (San Diego Padres), Trent Grisham (New York Yankees), Spencer Strider (Atlanta Braves), Coleman Crow (Milwaukee Brewers), and Chase Dollander (Colorado Rockies).

The Chicago White Sox made a significant trade, acquiring RF Nolan Jones and cash from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations. Additionally, the White Sox traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers also made a trade, acquiring RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by a strong performance from their starting pitcher. Sandy Alcantara pitched 8.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers at the plate with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera and Jordan Walker contributing significantly to the win.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Evan Carter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
